Book Title: Paw Patrol Phonics Box Set (PAW Patrol) (Step into Reading)
Author: Jennifer Liberts, Mike Jackson
Publisher: Random House Books for Young Readers
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Literature & Fiction > Chapter Books & Readers > Beginner Readers
Summary: This Step into Reading boxed set includes 12 full-color phonics readers featuring the pups of Nickelodeon’s  PAW Patrol ! Each book features a specific phonics concept that will give boys and girls ages 3 to 7 the tools they need to begin reading on their own.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find these phonics books effective for teaching new readers, helping them learn words and letters through repetition. The books are super cute and easy for beginners to read, with customers noting their child reads books 1-4 like a champ. While some customers consider them a great product for the price, others find them not worth the money. The books receive mixed feedback about their length, with several noting they're only 5 pages long, and customers express concerns about their sturdiness, describing them as flimsy.
Editorial Reviews (Text): About the Author Jennifer Liberts grew up in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and Agoura, California. She has a BA in English Literature from California State University, and an MFA in Poetry from Columbia University. She has worked as a children's book editor, an English teacher, and an independent bookseller. She lives in Portland, Oregon, with her three book-loving children, and an orange cat named Chuck. Mike Jackson is a children’s book illustrator. He graduated from the legendary ArtCenter School of Design in Pasadena, California, and has been making art for more than 25 years. He has illustrated several books, including The Best Doghouse Ever!
